briefings.title: Bo Hines on Building America’s Regulated Dollar [Avalanche Summit NYC]
briefings.tldr: Bo Hines (CEO of Tether USA) and Charley Cooper (President of Ava Labs) discuss the launch of Aave’s V4 RWA hub on Avalanche using Tether as its inaugural stablecoin, while outlining how the Genius Act and regulatory clarity are driving traditional financial institutions toward 24/7 onchain settlement.
